type: Two explicit shared rectangular column-to-horizontal-lintel ports
topology: One connected closed oriented manifold, Euler characteristic 2
column_rings: 8 stations x 8 points on each support, elliptical first six, RECT8 final two
port: Remove corresponding lintel bottom grid cells. Registry reuses all eight actual perimeter vertices of each column final ring; two unused hole-center grid vertices pruned. No overlap or implicit boolean.
registry: Input coordinate key rounded to 10 decimal places; only declared G0 port/beam grid matching. Subsequent reflection is constructed from actual CC parent/child genealogy, never nearest-position matching.
control_and_profile: Same vertex IDs, oriented face connectivity and semantic parts. Different section widths/depths and resulting port-grid coordinates. No other construction difference.
